description: Tableau connector (read-only). Indexes Tableau dashboards and views as `tableau:dashboard` items in the local index and exposes three read-only tools to the Nimbus agent (`tableau_list`, `tableau_get`, `tableau_search`). Uses the Tableau REST API with Personal Access Token (PAT) auth. The per-tenant server URL is supplied via the `tableau.url` vault key and its hostname is added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddTableauMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
